messages:
Maya Iyer: nightly-eval flagged a regression for rdx-3b-v2-int4 on the 'instructional-turns' cohort, delta = -7.2% accuracy vs baseline. eval-bot pasted summary below.

eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval (2025-11-04 06:00 UTC) - suite: instructionalfewshot_v2 - model: rdx-3b-v2-int4 - fail cohorts: instruction-following-turns (p=0.001, delta -7.2%). See /evals/weekly/1765432/report.html

Ashwin Patel: rough severity? surface-level impact to users?

Maya Iyer: tends to affect multi-turn instruction chains, short-term critical for a handful of customers using dedicated int4 stacks. marking P2 for now.

Jin Park: assigning to me for initial triage. any repro snippets?

Maya Iyer: dropping top failing prompt examples and one bad generation: ```
PROMPT: "Refactor this loop to be more efficient and explain changes."
EXPECTED: code refactor + short explanation
ACTUAL (risky): repeats the same line, introduces incorrect variable reuse, and truncates explanation
--- sample generation ---
for i in range(n):
    print(i)
for i in range(n):
    print(i)
...
```

Ashwin Patel: could be quantization-induced attention smoothing or a KV cache alignment bug. also check recent kernel roll from runtime team (k=quant-2025-10-31).

Jin Park: quick repro locally: ran eval harness on dev-gpu with model artifact rdx-3b-v2-int4@2025-10-30 and saw same repeated-line pattern on 6/20 failing prompts. pushing logs to /tmp/jin/1765432/rep.log

Jin Park: suspicious stack trace: ```
RuntimeWarning: kvcache_mismatch: expected seq_len=128 but found 64 in stream 3
 at runtime/kv_cache.cpp:214
```

Maya Iyer: that matches a small subset of nightly errors we saw earlier. we had a kv-cache fix deployed to canary yesterday, might be related. tagging eng-runtime.

Ashwin Patel: @Jin can you try toggling prefix_cache off and rerun? if it disappears, we can blame cache interactions.

Jin Park: toggled prefix_cache=false; repro gone for those prompts. with prefix_cache=true it reproduces reliably.

Jin Park: hypothesis: new quant kernel + prefix cache alignment leads to stale KV segments for certain prompt alignments -> repeated tokens.

Maya Iyer: owner assignment: Jin (triage/shortterm), Ashwin (eval/metric impact), eng-runtime oncall for kernel rollback decision.

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-20251104-0421 - nightly-eval regression rdx-3b-v2-int4 - assigned to Jin Park.

Jin Park: next steps: 1) produce minimal reproducer and add to nightly testset; 2) run canary rollback to previous quant kernel patch; 3) add detection rule for kv mismatch logs in console alerts.

Maya Iyer: adding reproducer to /evals/regressions/rdx-3b-v2-int4/kvcache-repro.txt and creating a short eval-suite that runs only those seeds.

Ashwin Patel: I'll draft a short customer note if rollback needed. keep me posted. :thumbsup:

Jin Park: ETA for first repro commit + logs: +35m. will update thread.

Maya Iyer: thanks. if eng-runtime wants to roll the quant kernel back, please coordinate with infra before EOD.

Jin Park: update: posted reproducer + CI job at 1765432567, failing as expected. pinged @eng-runtime.

sre-bot: rollback preflight check: ok for canary, flagged for schedule window 2h.

Maya Iyer: triage complete for now. leaving open for follow-up after kernel decision. :white_check_mark:
